label: Reward model
intent: The reward model scores the outputs and rewards the better one. Light: the reward star spins one point and stops with a small overshoot, and the preferred output on the right jumps up and lands with a hit. Strong: the star winds back and spins two points with a settle; the preferred output jumps higher and bounces once while the other output sinks a little and recovers. The star ends on its exact starting angle.

reward.//: the star is a regular five-point star centred at (16, 11): 72 degrees maps it onto itself

reward.rotate.//: each spin ends on a symmetric pose, then an invisible step back to 0 so the last frame is the exact rest drawing

candidate-left.y.//: Strong only: the other output gets the lower reward
